containers.name: runtime
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,time,zlib,base64
p=Path("/tmp/identity-likelihood");p.mkdir()
files=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
for n,t in files.items():(p/n).write_text(t)
with (p/"run.log").open("w") as f:
 r=subprocess.run(['python3', '/tmp/identity-likelihood/diagnose.py', '--root', '/tmp/identity-likelihood', '--encode-only'],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(p/"exit.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exit_code":r.returncode}))
print(json.dumps({"exit_code":r.returncode}),flush=True)
time.sleep(1500)
